description:
Open the Relationships designer in LibreOffice Base and define three foreign key relationships between tables in the Chinook music store database.

The Chinook database is already open in LibreOffice Base at /home/ga/chinook.odb. Currently, no relationships (foreign key constraints) are defined between any tables.

Using the Relationships designer (Tools > Relationships), add the following three relationships:

1. Artist → Album: Connect Artist.ArtistId (primary key) to Album.ArtistId (foreign key)
2. Album → Track: Connect Album.AlbumId (primary key) to Track.AlbumId (foreign key)
3. Customer → Invoice: Connect Customer.CustomerId (primary key) to Invoice.CustomerId (foreign key)

For each relationship, drag the primary key column from the parent table onto the corresponding foreign key column in the child table within the Relationships designer window. Ensure the relationships are created successfully.

After creating all three relationships, save the database (Ctrl+S) to persist the foreign key constraints.
